messages:
samir: Heads-up — I'm reworking the Quickstart HelloMini onboarding to cover an auth edgecase we saw: when devs use MFA-backed KMS tokens the local credential helper can fall back to an empty file. Opening a WIP PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123. Need someone to review the auth snippets, devcontainer steps, and a11y notes.

miriam: Taking a look. Can we also explicitly call out the env var name confusion (`REDWOOD_API_KEY` vs `REDWOOD_TOKEN`)? A lot of folks hit that.

jonah: I hit that yesterday — CI failed because our test harness expects `REDWOOD_API_KEY` but some examples still use `REDWOOD_TOKEN`. Quick interim: set both in CI until we standardize.

tina: I can update the snippet and add a tiny fallback script so examples stay simple. Suggest adding this inline to the quickstart: 
```
# local dev fallback (keeps examples stable)
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=${REDWOOD_API_KEY:-$REDWOOD_TOKEN}
```

miriam: Also please add a11y note for the "copy token" button — need an aria-label for screen readers and a short bit about keyboard focus.

samir: Good call. I'll add `aria-label="Copy API token"` and a one-line tip about storing tokens locally at `~/.redwood/credentials` (opt-in).

docs-bot: link-checker: broken link found in tutorial -> /sdk/v3/auth (404). Flagged this morning and attached to the PR.

jonah: I'll change the link to `/sdk/latest/auth` and push a fix in a follow-up commit.

tina: One more devcontainer nit: we mount `~/.redwood` as a volume; need to ensure correct ownership for the `vscode` user. Suggest adding to Dockerfile: 
```
RUN mkdir -p /home/vscode/.redwood && chown vscode:vscode /home/vscode/.redwood
```

samir: :thumbsup: will incorporate both the permission change and the env fallback. Can someone run the smoke CI after I push the edits? I want to validate the e2e flow (the flake we saw yesterday).

miriam: I can queue the smoke run once you push. Ping me when it's up @miriam.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: smoke run queued for PR #4123 — will post results in this thread once complete.

samir: Thanks all — aiming to merge Wed AM. If anyone wants to pair on the a11y wording, @tina let's sync ~30m after the push.
